```{r}
# =========================
# Prize Explorer Shiny App
# =========================

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# ---- Load and clean data ----
data <- read.csv("prizes.csv")

# Convert year to numeric (in case it’s read as character)
data$prize_year <- as.numeric(data$prize_year)

# ---- UI ----
ui <- navbarPage("Prize Explorer",

  # --- Tab 1: Overview ---
  tabPanel("Overview",
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        sliderInput("year_range", "Select Year Range:",
                    min = min(data$prize_year, na.rm = TRUE),
                    max = max(data$prize_year, na.rm = TRUE),
                    value = c(min(data$prize_year, na.rm = TRUE),
                              max(data$prize_year, na.rm = TRUE))),
        selectInput("genre_filter", "Select Prize Genre:",
                    choices = c("All", unique(data$prize_genre)), selected = "All")
      ),
      mainPanel(
        h4("Number of Prizes by Year"),
        plotlyOutput("trend_plot"),
        h4("Distribution of Prize Genres"),
        plotlyOutput("genre_plot")
      )
    )
  ),

  # --- Tab 2: Gender & Diversity ---
  tabPanel("Gender & Diversity",
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        selectInput("gender_genre", "Filter by Prize Genre:",
                    choices = c("All", unique(data$prize_genre)), selected = "All")
      ),
      mainPanel(
        h4("Gender Distribution of Winners"),
        plotlyOutput("gender_plot"),
        h4("Ethnicity Distribution of Winners"),
        plotlyOutput("ethnicity_plot")
      )
    )
  ),

  # --- Tab 3: Education & Prize ---
  tabPanel("Education & Prize",
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        selectInput("edu_genre", "Filter by Prize Genre:",
                    choices = c("All", unique(data$prize_genre)), selected = "All")
      ),
      mainPanel(
        h4("Winners by Highest Degree"),
        plotlyOutput("degree_plot"),
        h4("Fields of Study and Prize Categories"),
        plotlyOutput("field_plot")
      )
    )
  ),

  # --- Tab 4: Book Analysis ---
  tabPanel("Book Analysis",
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        sliderInput("book_year", "Select Year Range:",
                    min = min(data$prize_year, na.rm = TRUE),
                    max = max(data$prize_year, na.rm = TRUE),
                    value = c(min(data$prize_year, na.rm = TRUE),
                              max(data$prize_year, na.rm = TRUE)))
      ),
      mainPanel(
        h4("Top Awarded Books"),
        plotlyOutput("book_rank"),
        h4("Top Authors by Number of Prizes"),
        plotlyOutput("author_rank")
      )
    )
  ),

  # --- Tab 5: Custom Explorer ---
  tabPanel("Custom Explorer",
    fluidRow(
      column(4, selectInput("xvar", "X Variable", names(data))),
      column(4, selectInput("yvar", "Y Variable", names(data))),
      column(4, selectInput("colorvar", "Group By", c("None", names(data))))
    ),
    plotlyOutput("custom_plot")
  )
)

# ---- Server ----
server <- function(input, output) {

  # ---- Reactive filtered data ----
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    df <- data
    if (input$genre_filter != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(prize_genre == input$genre_filter)
    }
    df %>% filter(prize_year >= input$year_range[1],
                  prize_year <= input$year_range[2])
  })

  # ---- Overview Plots ----
  output$trend_plot <- renderPlotly({
    plot <- filtered_data() %>%
      group_by(prize_year) %>%
      summarise(n = n()) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = prize_year, y = n)) +
      geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
      geom_point(color = "steelblue") +
      labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of Prizes",
           title = "Number of Prizes by Year") +
      theme_minimal()
    ggplotly(plot)
  })

  output$genre_plot <- renderPlotly({
    plot <- data %>%
      count(prize_genre) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = reorder(prize_genre, n), y = n, fill = prize_genre)) +
      geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(x = "Prize Genre", y = "Count",
           title = "Distribution of Prize Genres") +
      theme_minimal()
    ggplotly(plot)
  })

  # ---- Gender & Diversity ----
  output$gender_plot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- if (input$gender_genre == "All") data else data %>% filter(prize_genre == input$gender_genre)
    plot <- df %>%
      count(gender) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = gender, y = n, fill = gender)) +
      geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
      labs(x = "Gender", y = "Count", title = "Gender Distribution") +
      theme_minimal()
    ggplotly(plot)
  })

  output$ethnicity_plot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- if (input$gender_genre == "All") data else data %>% filter(prize_genre == input$gender_genre)
    plot <- df %>%
      count(ethnicity_macro) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = reorder(ethnicity_macro, n), y = n, fill = ethnicity_macro)) +
      geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(x = "Ethnicity (Macro)", y = "Count",
           title = "Ethnicity Distribution of Winners") +
      theme_minimal()
    ggplotly(plot)
  })

  # ---- Education & Prize ----
  output$degree_plot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- if (input$edu_genre == "All") data else data %>% filter(prize_genre == input$edu_genre)
    plot <- df %>%
      count(highest_degree) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = reorder(highest_degree, n), y = n, fill = highest_degree)) +
      geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(x = "Highest Degree", y = "Count",
           title = "Distribution of Highest Degrees") +
      theme_minimal()
    ggplotly(plot)
  })

  output$field_plot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- if (input$edu_genre == "All") data else data %>% filter(prize_genre == input$edu_genre)
    plot <- df %>%
      count(degree_field_category, prize_genre) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = degree_field_category, y = n, fill = prize_genre)) +
      geom_col(position = "dodge") +
      labs(x = "Field of Study", y = "Count",
           title = "Fields of Study vs Prize Genres") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    ggplotly(plot)
  })

  # ---- Book Analysis ----
  output$book_rank <- renderPlotly({
    plot <- data %>%
      filter(prize_year >= input$book_year[1],
             prize_year <= input$book_year[2]) %>%
      count(book_title, sort = TRUE) %>%
      head(15) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = reorder(book_title, n), y = n)) +
      geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(x = "Book Title", y = "Number of Prizes",
           title = "Top 15 Awarded Books") +
      theme_minimal()
    ggplotly(plot)
  })

  output$author_rank <- renderPlotly({
    plot <- data %>%
      filter(prize_year >= input$book_year[1],
             prize_year <= input$book_year[2]) %>%
      count(name, sort = TRUE) %>%
      head(15) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = reorder(name, n), y = n)) +
      geom_col(fill = "seagreen") +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(x = "Author", y = "Number of Prizes",
           title = "Top 15 Awarded Authors") +
      theme_minimal()
    ggplotly(plot)
  })

  # ---- Custom Explorer ----
  output$custom_plot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- data
    if (input$colorvar == "None") {
      plot <- ggplot(df, aes_string(x = input$xvar, y = input$yvar)) +
        geom_point() +
        theme_minimal()
    } else {
      plot <- ggplot(df, aes_string(x = input$xvar, y = input$yvar, color = input$colorvar)) +
        geom_point() +
        theme_minimal()
    }
    ggplotly(plot)
  })
}

# ---- Run App ----
shinyApp(ui, server)

```
